$comment: Accepted risks: findings that do not fail the run (scripts/security-report.mjs). Each entry names the tool, the id of the finding (a CVE, a rule), optionally a part of its location, why it is accepted and until when (YYYY-MM-DD): after that date it fails the run again and must be looked at once more.

risks.reason: a regular expression for the certificate fields of mTLS rules is a feature the administrator writes (Hosts → mTLS); it is validated (one expression, at most 200 characters, no quotes or line breaks) and only the administrator can save it
not a stored password hash: the id of the CrowdSec machine is derived from its random 256-bit password so that a new password is a new machine; the password itself is never stored hashed
the example of the API schema of NPMplus (upload of a custom certificate): a published sample key, not a key of NPMOS
